_comment: Measured baseline for scripts/lab/hideout_footprint.py (#935), from On-call's lab runs on main b6ce0081 (11/10, after #967): the max of the window-shown and window-hidden runs. A metric fails past value * (1 + pct/100) + slack, or past max where an entry has one. loop_wakes_per_s is the gate's wake limit (#1000): the hub's own event-loop wakes, at most 2/s hidden to the tray with no flyout and at most 5/s shown (loop_wakes_shown_per_s), set 11/10 from On-call's 2bc31b90 runs (hidden ~1.6/s, shown ~4.4/s, nearly all cause 'other', CPU 0.03-0.17 %; the Hub raised the limits from 1/s at that cost). wakeups_per_s (context switches, mostly the NVIDIA OpenGL driver thread and other OS work) is recorded as INFO only and never fails; its value is kept for reference (see docs/hideout-footprint.md). Private memory ~75 MB is the glow/egui/GPU stack floor on this machine. The default set is empty for now, so it shares the numbers.
